knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The clamp type determines how the head is released and refitted, so it must be identified first.
A gentle method tested in a small area avoids scratching or dulling a floor finish.
Soil on a dirty head or pad can spread to clean surfaces or to clean heads if it is not bagged.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the clamp type and changes a bucket head so that a tug test shows it is held firm.
Removes and refits a flat pad using the holder and hook-and-loop, without contaminating the clean pad.
Tests a heel-mark method in a small area before full use and reports marks that do not lift.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Scouring pad used on a sealed floor without a test
Head or pad fitted with contaminated gloves
Loose head used on a mop
